{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Confirm the cleaning worked
print("First 5 cleaned revenue values:")
print(df['revenue_clean'].head())

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print("\nCount of internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99):")
print(df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99].shape[0])

# Check for refunded orders
print("\nCount of refunded orders:")
print(df[df['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0])"}
